recipes.title: Bacon, Spinach & Gruyère Cottage Cheese Egg Bites
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and grease a 6-cup muffin tin or silicone egg bite mould.
Blend the eggs and cottage cheese until smooth.
Divide the bacon, spinach, green onion, rosemary and cheese between the cups, then pour the egg mixture over to about three-quarters full. Season.
Bake 17–20 minutes until set and lightly golden. Cool a few minutes before unmoulding.
recipes.notes: Ingredients, steps and calories are the creator's; she only lists calories, so protein, carbs and fat are my estimate. For veggie bites skip the bacon and add mushrooms, peppers or broccoli.
